question.problem:
$$
{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)=\{\begin{aligned}2y, & \,0\le y\le 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. 
Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=1]$ given that the conditional probability density function ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)$ is shown above and the corresponding expected value is ${\mu }_{Y|1}=\frac{2}{3}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=x] & =\text{E}[(Y-{\mu }_{Y|x})^{2}\,|\,X=x] \\  & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

where 

$$
\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)\,\text{d}y.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=1] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{y}^{2}\cdot 2y\,\text{d}x \\  & =2{\int }_{0}^{1}{y}^{3}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={[\frac{2{y}^{4}}{4}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}-0 \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=1] & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=1]-{\mu }_{Y|1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}-{(\frac{2}{3})}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}-\frac{4}{9} \\  & =\frac{1}{18}.\end{aligned}
$$
